title: HookRequest
description: JSON-RPC request the core API sends to the service a resource write addresses. `before_create` fires before the write and may veto it; `after_create` fires after the write with the stored row.

resource.description: The core resource being written, e.g. evy.messages.

data.description: For before_create: the client-supplied create payload. For after_create: the row as written (ids and timestamps final).
